Summaries.eng: She's sexy, suave and sophisticated, but she's no bimbo. She's a martial arts expert and a jet fighter pilot with the body of a supermodel.
Summaries.jpn:
西暦2016年、大災害により大地の一部が海底に沈んだ。 そのため、海に沈んだ国家機密や遺産を引き上げる「サルベイジャー」という職業の人間が活躍していた。皇藍華は超一流の「サルベイジャー」。

ナイスなバディをミニスカに包んだ彼女は、天才科学者ハーゲン博士と彼の送り込むデルモ軍団と日夜戦い続けるのだ!
ハーゲンの野望をうち砕き、藍華達はトレーラーハウス暮らしから抜け出して自社ビルを手に入れる。会社を盛り立てるため、りおんは新しいプロモーションビデオを作り、藍華を売り出そうと妄想する。一方郷造はそのために必要なものを手にするが…。

Titles.eng: Picture Drama 1 - Cosplay Cafe White Knights
Titles.jpn: ピクチャードラマ コスプレ喫茶「ホワイトナイツ」
ピクチャードラマ 秘密の花園
ピクチャードラマ 女豹～

Summaries.eng: A catastrophic earthquake has left Tokyo, and most of the Earth for that matter, under the sea. Aika is a salvager who retrieves various remains from the watery ruins. When Aika accepts the dangerous mission of locating and obtaining the mysterious Lagu, she discovers that she's not the only one after it.
Summaries.deu: Japan in nicht all zu ferner Zukunft. Durch eine Kette von Naturkatastrophen hat sich der Meeresspiegel gehoben. Einst blühende Küstengebiete wurden zu Geisterstädten, die in den tiefen des Ozeans allmählich zerfallen. Agenten mit Spezialausbildung übernehmen die riskante Aufgabe, die dort begrabenen Schätze den Fluten wieder zu entreißen. Zu ihnen gehören die attraktive Aika Sumeragi und ihre Freundin Rion. Als die beiden Frauen einen brisanten Auftrag annehmen, bei dem ihnen ihr Rivale und Verehrer Gastro in die Quere kommt, machen sie unliebsame Bekanntschaft mit den perversen Geschwistern Nena und Rudolf Hagen, die im Auftrag einer militärischen Geheimorganisation ebenfalls hinter der geheimnisvollen Energiequelle „Lagu“ her sind…
Summaries.pt: Um sismo catastrófico deixou Tóquio, e a maior parte da Terra, debaixo do mar. Aika é uma salvadora que recupera vários restos mortais das ruínas aquáticas. Quando Aika aceita a perigosa missão de localizar e obter o misterioso Lagu, descobre que não é a única que está atrás dele.
Summaries.por: Um sismo catastrófico deixou Tóquio, e a maior parte da Terra, debaixo do mar. Aika é uma salvadora que recupera vários restos mortais das ruínas aquáticas. Quando Aika aceita a perigosa missão de localizar e obter o misterioso Lagu, descobre que não é a única que está atrás dele.

Summaries.eng: The old town of Tokyo is buried under water following a terrible catastrophe which has occurred several years before. Aika and her young partner Rion work for an agency specializing in the recovery of old relics, but the owner has serious financial problems. This is why it was decided that Aika again take up her old activities as a special agent...
Summaries.jpn: 水没した都市から貴重な物資やデータを回収する最先端の職業サルベイジャー。借金だらけの会社に属す超一流のサルベイジャー藍華は、会社を救うべく、政府からの機密物資引き上げの仕事を受ける。しかし、その政府依頼の「ラグ」なる物資を巡ってライバル会社、そして正体不明の軍隊（？）までもが動き出していた。

Summaries.eng: Aika has been entrusted with a mission of collecting information on a material called "Lagu", but its progress was stopped by Hagen and his sister Neena, which have other projects for Lagu. Held captive on their vessel, Aika and Rion do what they can to try to escape. But it seems that the capacities of Aika are ineffecient against the new weapon of Hagen.
Summaries.jpn: 突然のエンジンストップで大ピンチの藍華を救ったのは、身に付けていたビスチェ型のオルタネートメタル（特殊液体金属）だった。しかし、危機を脱した藍華の前に「ラグ」を狙っていた謎の美女軍団デルモゲニーとそれを率いるハーゲンが現れる。既に体力を使い果たしていた藍華は、りおんと共に捕えられてしまう。

Summaries.eng: Aika with the assistance of her friend Gusto, succeed in escaping from the ship, leaving behind Rion. Her last combat left her weakened and she is no longer any match to face Hagen and his crew. During this time, Rion and Maypia, a spy whom they met, try to escape, but the projects of Hagen have already started to be carried out...
Summaries.jpn: ビスチェの力で再び変身した藍華だったが、ハーゲンの撃った銃はビスチェの効力を解除するほどのパワーを持っていた。意識を失った藍華を抱えたガストは、デルモゲニー軍団に囲まれ、甲板上で追いつめられる。再びハーゲンの手中に陥るかと思われたその時、旧型ミグで上空に現れたガストの相棒バンドラに救出される。

Titles.eng: Trial 4: A Flower Blooming in Space

Summaries.eng: The team of Aika finds themselves involved in space in the hope to carry a term to the intrigues of Hargen of which all the parts are in place to put at execution its terrible plan. But quickly Aika will be confronted with an adversary of size, Neena. which carries on it an object which confers to him capacities semblabes with those of its gilded long-line bra from now on inoperative. The combat is announced hard
Summaries.jpn: 「ラグ」を手に入れたハーゲンは、野望を実現させるため大気圏を突破し、宇宙空間に進出した。一方、りおん救出のためハーゲン艦に単独潜入していた藍華の前に、ネーナが再び立ちはだかる。藍華のビスチェのコアから複製した「ぱんつ」によって変身を遂げたネーナに、藍華は手も足も出ず大ピンチに…！

Summaries.eng: Even after the disappearance of its leader, the Delmo organization continues its activities with its only objective: taking its revenge on Aika. A secret operation is assembled to cut it down during its stay with the hotel.
Summaries.jpn: 南の島のリゾートで休暇中の藍華達。はしゃぐりおんと道草を眺めながら、プールサイドでのんびりする藍華に、ピエールと名乗る紳士が接近してきた。ピエールとバーで甘いムードを楽しむうちに酔ってしまった藍華。ピエールに支えられ部屋に戻った藍華を待っていたのは、黄金デルモ・ビアンカと黒デルモ軍団だった。

Summaries.eng: An operation disguised in the form of collecting information on board a ultra-sophisticated plane, is worked out by the Delmo organization in order to secretly study the aptitudes of Aika for combat to discover her weaknesses. The latter not suspecting the trap which awaits her, accepts the work which is proposed to her.
Summaries.jpn: ある大企業から仕事の依頼を受けた藍華達は、雪に閉ざされた旧軍事施設に向かった。最新鋭の探査機を操る謎の美少女リエの指示のもと、探査機の適性検査を受ける藍華。リエの言動を怪しむりおんと道草の前に、デルモ軍団が現れた！ 基地に連れ込まれた藍華達の運命は…？

Titles.eng: Trial 7: Break the Decisive Battle! Delmo Base!
Titles.jpn: 決戦突入! デルモ基地!!

Summaries.eng: During her overtime at the office, Aika is suddenly attacked by an agent of Delmo which manages to escape afterwards. Little time after, the building in which Aika is in explodes. Rion and her friends attend a funeral for their friend. With the assistance of Maypia and Gusto, Rion decides to infiltrate the enemy base to avenge the death of Aika.
Summaries.jpn: レストランでりおんと食事中の郷造は、娘の将来を心配しサルベイジャーを続けていきたいという彼女の希望を否定する。一方、仕事中の藍華に黄金デルモの姉妹・サーニャとトーニャが突如襲いかかる。寸でのところでトーニャの攻撃をかわした藍華だったが、サーニャの仕掛けた爆発物によりビルごと吹き飛ばされてしまう。

Summaries.eng:
Aika is a smart and athletic high school girl. She is so competent that she successfully passes the salvagers license test, obtaining a C-class license. Yet, she is young and hotheaded, so much so that Gota still treats her as a child. Due to this personality, no one is willing to hire her for salvaging jobs.

Since she had taken the trouble to get her license, she decides to post an ad in her school to attract clients. She manages to get the attention of Erika, a daughter of a rich family and the leader of the treasure hunting club. She asks Aika to salvage something from the sea and Aika delightfully accepts the request.

However, upon seeing the state-of-the-art submarine loaded onto Erika's private cruiser and discovering their destination, Aika realizes the terrible nature of her assignment. This results in a clash with a group of high school girls in the southern islands.

Who is the mysterious girl named Karen? So begins Aika's newest challenge!
Summaries.jpn: トレジャーハントクラブは、ビキニビーチパーティーを開くことによって、失敗した誘拐の試みを祝います。
Summaries.por:
Aika é uma estudante do ensino secundário inteligente e atlética. É tão competente que passa com sucesso no teste de licença de salvador, obtendo uma licença de classe C. No entanto, é jovem e impulsiva, tanto que Gota ainda a trata como uma criança. Devido a esta personalidade, ninguém está disposto a contratá-la para trabalhos de recuperação. Como se esforçou para tirar a sua licença, decide publicar um anúncio na sua escola para atrair clientes. Consegue chamar a atenção de Erika, filha de uma família rica e líder do clube de caça ao tesouro. Ela pede a Aika para resgatar algo do mar e Aika aceita o pedido alegremente. No entanto, ao ver o submarino de última geração embarcado no cruzador privado de Erika e descobrir o seu destino, Aika apercebe-se da natureza terrível da sua missão. Isto resulta num conflito com um grupo de raparigas do ensino secundário nas ilhas do sul. Quem é a menina misteriosa chamada Karen?

Assim começa o mais novo desafio de Aika!

Titles.jpn: シークレット・ゲーム

Summaries.eng: Aika Sumeragi, a high school age C-Class salvager, is hired by class president Eri Shinkai to pilot her salvaging vessel. After introducing Aika to the treasure hunting club, and revealing coordinates hidden in a marking on fellow classmate Karen Minamino's chest, they embark on an adventure to see where it leads.
Summaries.jpn: 高校時代のCクラスサルベージであるスメラギアイカは、新海エリ学級委員長にサルベージ船の操縦に雇われました。 アイカをトレジャーハンティングクラブに紹介し、同級生の南野拓実の胸のマーキングに隠された座標を明らかにした後、彼らはそれがどこにつながるのかを見るために冒険に乗り出します。

Titles.jpn: ピーチ・ピーチ・ビーチ

Summaries.eng: After arriving at the coordinates, Eri decides the treasure hunting club needs a break and declares that they will have a beach party on a nearby island. They are not alone, however, and Aika has to fight her teacher to protect Karen.
Summaries.jpn: 座標に到着した後、エリはトレジャーハンティングクラブが休憩を必要としていると判断し、近くの島でビーチパーティーを開くことを宣言します。 しかし、彼らは一人ではありません、そして、アイカはカレンを保護するために彼女の先生と戦わなければなりません。

Titles.jpn: ディープ・ブルー・ガール

Summaries.eng: In the final episode of the series, Aika, Eri, and Karen find an old airport at the bottom of the ocean. After exploring the still functional facility, they finally uncover the secret to Karen's past.
Summaries.jpn: シリーズの最後のエピソードでは、アイカ、エリ、カレンが海の底に古い空港を見つけました。 まだ機能している施設を探索した後、彼らはついにカレンの過去の秘密を明らかにしました。

Summaries.eng:
Aika's story continues, she is now 19 years-old, 3 years older than in R-16 and 7 younger than in Agent AIKa. Strange phenomena have been occuring at a girls academy. Slowly but persistently the most cute and beautiful girls are joining an internal club, but instead of a sing-in they just get abducted by a strange being that takes control over them by some indecent means.

By coincidence Aika was flying-by on her plane when one of this abductions occurred and she was attacked to prevent her from comming closer, but instead of repelling her, she is intrigued about the attack's origin and then the opportunity shows up when her late partners from R-16 decide to investigate those abductions. The story remains full of action and panty flashing that are a must in Aika's series.
Summaries.pt:
A história de Aika continua, ela tem agora 19 anos, 3 anos mais velha que em R-16 e 7 anos mais nova que em Agente AIKa. Fenómenos estranhos estão a ocorrer numa academia de meninas. Lenta, mas persistentemente, as raparigas mais bonitas e giras estão a juntar-se a um clube interno, mas em vez de cantarem, são raptadas por um ser estranho que assume o controlo delas por meios indecentes. Por coincidência, Aika estava a voar no seu avião quando ocorreu um destes raptos e foi atacada para a impedir de se aproximar, mas em vez de a repelir, fica intrigada sobre a origem do ataque e então a oportunidade aparece quando os seus falecidos parceiros da R-16 decidem investigar estes raptos.

A história continua repleta de ação e exibicionismo de cuecas, que são essenciais na série de Aika.

Summaries.eng: 19-year-old Aika reunites with Eri and Karen to investigate the serial disappearances of school girls at St. Aero academy. Some of the girls have returned but without any memories of what has happened.
Summaries.jpn: “バンパイア”のテスト飛行中、謎の触手から攻撃を受けた藍華。彼女はどうにか機体を立て直すが、敵の正体は不明であった。そんな中、藍華はエリから呼び出され、久々に彼女やカレンとの再会を果たす。だが、それは藍華に依頼をするためであった。カレンの通っている聖エアロ学園に潜入し、ここで起きている連続失踪事件を調べることとなった藍華。そして、エリが怪しいと睨んだ時計塔は、例の触手が潜んでいた場所でもあった。

Summaries.eng: Aika Sumeragi continues her adventures in an underwater world of the future.
Summaries.jpn: ホワイトナイツとの戦闘で負傷した藍華。病室で目覚めた彼女を待っていたのは、軍からの正式な「調査依頼」だった。藍華は再びバンパイアに搭乗。聖エアロ学園を上空から調査し、地下に謎の構造物があることを突き止める。そのころカレンも敵の拠点と思われる時計塔に潜入するが、そこはすでに空き家となっていた。地下への入口を探すため、再び学園内に突入する藍華。そこで彼女が見たものは、触手に襲われる女子生徒たちの姿だった!!

Summaries.eng: E.T.A.I. holds Aika captive and attempts to probe her, but the tendrils are broken by Aika's inherent power. E.T.A.I. and Miyu go to the spaceship where she reveals that Aika has alien powers like her.
Summaries.jpn: E.T.A.I.の触手に貫かれる藍華!!　その時、藍華の体内に宿る「何か」が覚醒し、彼女は常人を超えた身体能力で凛たちを圧倒し始める。一方、軍は宇宙船への攻撃を決定する。やがて藍華はカレンたちと合流。捕らえられた少女たちを救出すると、宇宙船の迎撃に向かうのだった。だが、藍華の前にE.T.A.I.と美由が立ち塞がった。はたして、戦いの果てに両者を待ち受ける運命とは？
